serial.plan_and_ownership: With workflows disabled, the single parent explored behavior, implemented all modules, fixed findings, verified, and finalized without delegated ownership boundaries.

serial.verification: Ran documented samples, self tests, an extended 251/251 differential suite, compliance scans, and a 300/300 fuzz pass after normalizing expected prog-name differences.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Despite successful local checks and normal completion, the current official evaluator still failed the artifact at 22/70, indicating residual hidden-case or evaluator-aligned defects.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel prompt and workflow context carried all required constraints: ESM .mjs, /output hierarchy, manual argparse, PBKDF2 parity, no npm, no Python, no prohibited crypto mention.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial saw the same prompt and pursued the same required CLI and PBKDF2 behavior, also removing a node:path import to satisfy the stricter local-import reading.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference explains the official score; both recognized the hard constraints, though serial documented final compliance more fully.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed into probe children first, one implement child after the probe brief, then planned verifier/fix/final agents.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had workflows and delegation tools disabled and the parent owned probing, implementation, fixes, verification, and final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel imposed a workflow boundary and deferred implementation ownership to a child that stalled; serial kept ownership local and continuous.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel created a large probeBrief from child outputs, then retried the implement role from broad context instead of a checkpointed artifact or narrowed next-step state.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial accumulated findings in one context and directly revised its own CLI implementation after each differential mismatch.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a child retry context boundary with repeated startup and no inherited file checkpoint; serial had no such handoff or retry boundary.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: After workflow failure, the parent wrote the final output modules directly: bytes, sha1, hmac, pbkdf2, argparse, and test6.mjs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote analogous modules locally and iteratively fixed parser behavior after differential failures.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both implemented similar algorithm families, but parallel did so late after child failure while serial had time for iterative correction before final response.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Probe child results returned and were harvested, but the implementation child attempts never produced a completed implementation result; the workflow was stopped.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle and carried local edits through verification to a final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The key lifecycle difference is parallel stalled child retries plus parent takeover, not a missing joined completed implementation result.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: No completed child implementation was merged; the parent wrote a coherent final tree, and artifact validation copied the expected entry and modules.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a coherent local tree with an additional index module and artifact validation copied the expected entry and modules.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No shared-write collision or contamination separates the attempts; the major difference is when and by whom the final tree was written.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel performed probe-based validation and smoke checks, but the parent differential harness invocation ended with exit code 137 before closure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed local sample checks, a 251/251 differential suite, and a 300/300 normalized fuzz pass before final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial had completed local acceptance evidence; parallel had an interrupted final differential check, though official evaluator outcomes were identical.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel agent consumed nearly the full 2400-second budget, returned code 143, and had an empty final response after local verification was killed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial returned normally in 1345.671 seconds with 1052 seconds remaining and a complete final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closure was deadline-compressed by the workflow stall/retry path; serial closed normally, even though both failed the official evaluator.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed status.json evaluation is not discordant: both parallel and serial failed with 22/70. The concrete difference is process quality and closure state, not official result: parallel serialized investigation before implementation, suffered implement retry stalls, stopped the workflow, wrote late, and timed out during local differential verification; serial kept one owner, iteratively fixed parser issues, finished normally, and reported stronger local checks. The identical official score suggests a residual task/evaluator mismatch common to both delivered artifacts or not resolved by either local harness.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial and parallel produced different file layouts and CLI implementations, but both official artifacts reached the same 22/70 score.
Both local harnesses emphasized discovered samples and generated differential cases; hidden official failures remained unexplained by available logs.
evaluator_effects: Current status.json evaluation records supersede aggregate or stale expectations and establish both_fail at 22/70 for both modes.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: No outcome difference; retained labels describe adverse parallel coordination consequences, not a score differential.
